Bash {"command":"cat > /tmp/audit_check.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

CLIENTS=("SkyhooksClient" "MercenaryClient" "AccessListsClient" "SovereigntyClient")
BASEDIR="/d/code/ESI.ts/src"
ERRORS=0

for client in "${CLIENTS[@]}"; do
  echo "=== Checking $client ==="
  
  # Layer 1: Client class file
  if [ -f "$BASEDIR/clients/${client}.ts" ]; then
    echo "✓ Layer 1: Client class exists"
  else
    echo "✗ Layer 1: Client class MISSING"
    ((ERRORS++))
  fi
  
  # Layer 2: Endpoints file (need to handle naming)
  clientLower=$(echo "$client" | sed 's/Client$//' | sed 's/\([a-z]\)\([A-Z]\)/\1-\2/g' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
  if [ -f "$BASEDIR/core/endpoints/${clientLower}Endpoints.ts" ] || [ -f "$BASEDIR/core/endpoints/${clientLower}endpoints.ts" ]; then
    echo "✓ Layer 2: Endpoints file exists"
  else
    echo "✗ Layer 2: Endpoints file MISSING (looked for: ${clientLower}Endpoints.ts)"
    ((ERRORS++))
  fi
  
  # Layer 3: Types file
  typesLower=$(echo "$client" | sed 's/Client$//' | sed 's/\([a-z]\)\([A-Z]\)/\1-\2/g' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
  if [ -f "$BASEDIR/types/${typesLower}.ts" ] || [ -f "$BASEDIR/types/${typesLower}s.ts" ] || [ -f "$BASEDIR/types/${typesLower}-lists.ts" ]; then
    echo "✓ Layer 3: Types file exists"
  else
    echo "✗ Layer 3: Types file MISSING (looked for: ${typesLower}.ts)"
    ((ERRORS++))
  fi
  
  echo
done

exit $ERRORS
EOF
bash /tmp/audit_check.sh
"}
